blocks.text: As we know that the earliest organisms on the Earth were prokaryotes who originated in a very unstable environment from the reactions of organic molecules about 3.5 billion years ago. About 2 billion years ago, eukaryotes evolved from prokaryotes. The “Endosymbiotic Theory” is the most acceptable theory for the evolution of prokaryotes into eukaryotes.
